_comment: BrainMark configuration. Every value here is a PIN: changing one invalidates the seal manifest's config_sha256 and report.py will say so.

pools._comment: HF SWE-bench pools for the FULL-POOL miner (plan 0.1). Downloaded once by pool_loaders.py into cache_dir as normalized JSON; every later step reads that cache offline. `revision` is the HF commit sha the pool is pinned to -- null means 'resolve at download time and record it', never 'whatever is current at mine time'. Merge order is (priority, name), so flag order cannot move a result. Sizes checked 2026-08-18 via datasets-server: SWE-bench 120.1 MB / 21527 rows, _Verified 2.1 MB / 500, _Multilingual 1.9 MB / 300, _Multimodal 1.9 MB / 612 -- 126 MB total, far under the 10 GB download ceiling.

swe_bench_multimodal._disabled_reason: LICENSE UNVERIFIED: the HF card declares no license (cardData.license is null, checked 2026-08-18). Plan 0.10 requires a per-pool license audit before inclusion and NeurIPS D&B desk-checks it. Flip to true only after the audit clears.

clone._comment: repo-cache filling (plan 0.1). Partial clones: the ancestry gate needs the commit graph, not file history. Never full-clone -- disk is shared.

fresh._comment: Fresh post-cutoff ROBUSTNESS split (plan 0.2/0.3). Analyzed separately, NEVER pooled with the main candidates. SNAPSHOT.json is the determinism boundary: the first run freezes the PR list, every later run reads it.

_arms_note: full_brain is the ONLY brain arm. no_brain is the baseline. The other three are competitors over the SAME pinned session-A bytes.

competitors._comment: Baseline dignity (plan 0.9). Every competitor runs its PUBLISHED DEFAULT config; exactly one tuning pass is permitted, on the dev split only, and it must be logged in COMPETITORS.md. Pins below were resolved from the eg-memharness / graphify-parity v52 run provenance and independently re-verified 2026-08-18 -- see COMPETITORS.md for the source of every value and the procedure for the ones still unresolved.

mem0._llm_forced_deviation: FORCED, NOT A TUNING PASS. mem0's published default openai/gpt-4o-mini is NOT DEPLOYED on the Azure AI Foundry resource BrainMark runs against (probed 2026-08-19: gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, gpt-5-mini and gpt-4.1-mini all return DeploymentNotFound; only gpt-5, gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-terra exist). mem0 is therefore given gpt-5.6-sol -- the SAME model the measured agent runs on, i.e. a STRONGER extractor than its own default. The deviation is CHARITABLE to mem0 and is disclosed rather than silently swapped. See COMPETITORS.md 'Forced deviations'.
mem0._embedder_forced_deviation: FORCED, NOT A TUNING PASS. mem0's default openai/text-embedding-3-small is unavailable: the Azure resource exposes NO embedding deployment at all (text-embedding-3-small, -3-large and ada-002 all return unknown_model; probed 2026-08-19). A local sentence-transformers embedder is used so the mem0 arm runs AT FULL STRENGTH instead of degrading to a null arm -- an arm that cannot embed retrieves nothing, and scoring that as 'memory did not help' is the easiest way to fake this benchmark's headline.
mem0._vector_store_note: mem0's own default store, in-memory, fresh per pair (a new Memory object per packet build), with dims matched to the forced embedder. Not a deviation in kind -- only the width follows the embedder.
mem0._provenance_note: Every mem0 packet echoes the OBSERVED mem0.__version__ plus the resolved llm/embedder/vector_store and top_k (memsources/mem0_source.py:observed_provenance), so a report proves what ran rather than what was configured.
mem0._prior_deviation_note: SUPERSEDED. BrainMark previously kept mem0's published gpt-4o-mini default and recorded the eg-memharness azure_ai/gpt-5.6-terra extractor as a deviation NOT taken. That choice is no longer available: the published defaults are not deployable on this resource. The deviations above are forced by availability, not chosen for score.

graphify._note: bridge/source/python null => inherit GRAPHIFY_BRIDGE / GRAPHIFY_SOURCE / GRAPHIFY_PYTHON, matching eg-memharness graphify_client.py defaults. The defaults baked into that client are REMOTE VM paths (/home/suhaan_entire_io/...) and are not valid on this machine -- they must be set before a graphify arm runs.
graphify._mode_note: structural = 0-LLM extraction, the mode the parity harness sealed. `--backend <model>` semantic mode is the LLM variant and is NOT the published default.

patch.name: cmm-v0.9.0-markdown-sections
patch._why: The SHIPPED v0.9.0 binary excludes Section nodes from its BM25 result set, so on a prose/markdown corpus it indexes everything and retrieves NOTHING (a NULL ARM -- it produced 1050 byte-identical empty contexts in the v52 matrix). This one-line patch drops Section from the exclusion list and nothing else. Running the patched build is the CHARITABLE choice and is disclosed; an unpatched cmm column would be retrieval-vs-nothing, not a product comparison.

cmm._binary_note: UNRESOLVED PIN: no compiled cmm artifact exists on this machine (cmm_client.py:65 points at a remote VM path; devenv/cmm is a dangling symlink). null => inherit CMM_BIN. The binary sha256 MUST be recorded into packet provenance at first run -- see COMPETITORS.md 'pin resolution'.
